summary: Greenbriar Sustainable Living Inc., a TSXV/OTC-listed real estate and renewable energy developer, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a Canadian material-change report) disclosing a non-brokered private placement of 2,200,000 units at CDN $0.45 per unit for gross proceeds of CDN $990,000. Each unit comprises one common share and a 36-month warrant exercisable at CDN $0.55. Insiders, including the CEO and President, are subscribing for 1.2 million units. Separately, the company will issue subscription agreements for CAD $6.5–8 million of convertible preferred shares at CAD $1.00, moving debt into equity. The filing is a routine capital-raising and balance-sheet cleanup notice, not a special situation.
